babs.1: What is reported about the Opening of the Book (al-Fatiha)
babs.2: "… not of those who have earned anger, nor of those who go astray"
babs.4: Mujahid said: "… to their devils" – their companions among the hypocrites and idolaters
babs.5: "And when We said: Enter this town and eat from it wherever you wish in abundance …"
babs.6: "And they say: Allah has taken a son. Glory be to Him!"
babs.9: "O Messenger, convey what has been revealed to you from your Lord"
babs.22: "And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Book …"
babs.28: And al-khab' is what you have hidden
